crownPassive.name: Steadfast
crownPassive.text: None of your heroes can be moved, frozen or stopped from acting, and Poison has no effect on them.

bond.name: Eventyr kin
bond.text: +1 Attack for each other Eventyr hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Steadfast stand
actions.text: Until the next round, he has +2 Guard and takes the first attack aimed at any of your other heroes.
